notes.title: Details of new content, open beta test and free DEMO.
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Following up on our previous announcement, we would like to inform you of the details of the new content that will be released this month, an open beta test and a free DEMO version.


The new arena mode will be called the “Ascension Mode.” 

[h3][b]About the Ascension Mode[/b][/h3]
In this mode, you will first be presented with two characters from which you will choose one to be your challenger to aim for the top of the tower. 

The challenger will start out with basic attributes and no equipment, from which you will be strengthening, using the rewards received for each victory at the battle floors. You will be presented three rewards from which you will be choosing one. 

Further, at certain floors there will be an Ascension Market at which you can use Ascension Coins to buy items and equipment. Ascension coins will be allotted at the beginning and for each victory.

In this mode, you will be given a great amount of freedom on how to strengthen your challenger, including the choice of the character itself, the equipment, and what to buy with your Ascension coins. Each decision you make will greatly affect the outcome of battle, and how far up you will be able to ascend, more so than the strategy during the battle itself.

[h3][b]Open Beta Test[/b][/h3]
As a bit of an experiment, we have decided to conduct an open beta test of the Ascension Mode. This beta build will be available as of this announcement, to those who are already playing ARIA CHRONICLE. Please understand that the beta build will only include the Ascension Mode. Follow the steps below if you wish to join in the beta test.

Procedure to opt-into the beta test:
1. In the library page of ARIA CHRONICLE, click Manage (the gear icon) on the top right corner and 
    click Properties. In the Properties, open the BETAS tab.

notes.title: Update September 16
notes.content:
v.1.0.1.0g

[h3][b]<Developer’s Note>[/b][/h3]
“Successor” difficulty is added for players who have easily cleared the Hard difficulty due to the balance issue in the early version and those who want a harder difficulty.
The enemies of the Successor difficulty has the same level of attack power as in the Hard difficulty, but with higher HP and Successor Difficulty-only new skills, passive, pattern, and etc. So even players who have already cleared the game will find it a new challenge.
Also, quests and reward items related to the new boss Glazzard the Ice Dragon, as well as legendary grade items for each job (available in all difficulty) are added.

In addition, the long-awaited feature of customization of heroes’ color is added.
*Customization of the heroes’ name will be added in future updates.
 
New arena mode is under development. We will keep you updated with the progress, please stay tuned, thank you!

[h3][b]<Additional Content>[/b][/h3]
- Boss Monster, Glazzard the Ice Dragon is added.
Quests from Chris can be expected after the first quest in The Ancient Capital has been cleared.
- Mythical grade defensive equipment of Clothes and Leather that can be obtained randomly are added.
- Successor Difficulty is added.
	- Based on Hard difficulty, various challenge elements is added.
	- HP of standard monster is increased by 5% for each level.
	- HP of boss monster is increased by 10% for each level.
	- Harmful Effect Resistance of bosses is increased by 10%.
	- Difficulty-only patterns and skills of bosses and Large Monsters is added.
	- Probability of Surprise Attack by enemies is double.

- Legendary grade items for each job are added.
	- When the Black Market has been upgraded to the highest level, legendary grade items become available.
	- Items can be exchanged with 3 Platinum Token that received from the elite boss in Arena.
	- 1 Platinum Token can be obtained from defeating level 8 enemy, 2 from level 9 and 3 from level 10.
	- Job-only items upgrade heroes’ skills and provide special passive effect. 
	- The material for Druid's "Leyden Reactor" is also changed to the Platinum Token.

Developer’s Comment: Like Druid’s Leyden Reactor, the characteristic of the job has been strengthened and the range of strategies has been broadened.

[h3][b]<Additional Feature>[/b][/h3]
- The feature of customization of the heroes’ color is added.
	
[h3][b]<Improvements>[/b][/h3]
- Effects of the Power Overwhelming and Dark Passenger has been changed to more powerful appearance.
- Saving the merchant in the dungeon allows you to sell items at the location.
- Items can also be sold at the arena.
- The price of second-hand items from the Dark Market and the items sold by merchants in the dungeon has been lowered by 20%.
- Fixed an issue that part of the face was hidden in the shield when Aria’s job was Warrior.
- Fixed an issue that the image was not shown correctly on the Monster Guide and Hero Details’ page. 

[h3][b]<Balance – Hero>[/b][/h3]
- Exile
*Increased Flesh From Bone HP bonus from 150% to 175％.
* Increased Bleeding damage of Gouge from 20% to 30%.
* Increased Bleeding damage of Gouge+ from 30% to 45%.
*Increased Dark damage of Pulverize from 50% to 75%.
*Increased MP damage bonus of Eradicate from 100% to 125%.
- Time Traveler
* Lowered duration of Time Bomb by 1.
- Invoker
*Increased attack power of Familiar in Urge from 1 to ２.
- Apparitor
*Increased Attack power of Familiar in Interrogate from 60% to 70%.
- Warrior
*Changed Cooldown of Endure from 2 to 1.
- Cook
*Added 1 turn of cooldown to Chop, Cooking Torch and Flash freeze.
- Druid
*Increased the effect rate of Poison Cloud from 60% to 75% and expanded the range of target to all enemies.
*Increased the effect rate of Poison Cloud+ from 80% to 85%, damage of acid from 30% to 50%.

Developer’s Comment: Statistically, the highest attack power has been recorded for Warrior and Rogue. Other heroes often operate with utility skills, which may be due to the differences in the skill composition of each job.
We have decided that it was necessary to adjust the heroes with low-expected attack power and raised the power of the core skills of each job.

- Increased the amount of exp when cleared level 6 quests or above.

[h3][b]<Balance – Item>[/b][/h3]
- Added Consumables Paper Charm, which carries the same effect as Paladin's Purification.

Developer’s Comment: We added Paper Charm as we have decided that more options are needed for our players in response to the additional of the Successor difficulty which enables enemies with new strengthening power.

- Increased gold / item acquisition-related effects for each equipment slightly.

[h3][b]<Balance – Monster and Battle>[/b][/h3]
- Fixed the formula for calculating continuous damage. 
The formula in the previous version: (Additional damage)=[(Damage*Remaining time) /(Duration of new damage)], but in the new version, the new damage effect will be added regardless of the duration.

For example: If the original damage is 10, with a Bleeding effect of the duration of 2 actions, when added with damage 10, and the duration of 3 actions, using the former formula, it will be (10*2) / 3 = 7 (rounded), and the resulting damage would be 17, with the duration of 3 actions. With the new formula, damage of 10 will be added to the original damage, which gives 20, and the duration will be 3 actions.

Developer’s Comment: The continuous damage effect was often felt to be weaker than normal damage. The formula has been modified so that the strategy of stacking continuous damage becomes an option.

- Changed the Electrocute itself also has Electrocute Resistance.
- Changed the duration of Frostbite from 3 actions to 2 turns.
	
Developer’s Comment: Even if Frostbite has been given, it was difficult for bosses to last it for more than one turn, and not very efficient. Therefore, the duration has been changed so that it will have a reliable hit assistance effect against bosses.

- Lowed the evasion rate for bosses by 3%

Developer’s Comment: The Boss Monster evasion rate has been reduced slightly to relieve the stress caused by frequent misses.
- Dietrich
* Deadly Nails can now be used even in the Back Line. Increased the speed for creating the alter egos.
* Mirror Image+ can now be used when HP drops to 50% or lower.
- Sasquatch
*Increased Cooldown for Rabies from 2 to 3.
*Increased Cooldown for Rabies+ from 1 to 2.
- Ogre
*Lowerd Damage Multiplier of Frenzy from 75% to 50%.
- Pit Fiend
*Base attack power drops by 1. 
- Pit Lord
*Added penalty of 10% to the accuracy of Brandish. 
- Faunus, Satyr
*Added penalty of 10% to the accuracy of Wheel Saw.
*Changed duration of Enrage to 2 actions.
- Mimic
*Reduced the encounter rate of Mimic and Fancy Mimic by 25%.
- Orc Chief
*Lowered Max HP increasing effect of Leadership from 75% to 60%.
- Purin the Witch
*Treated as large monster and evasion bonus in the back line is removed.
- Marron, Pudding
*Attacks from Marron and Pudding are no longer Countered.

Developer’s Comment: The issue where the counterattack-based strategies of Monk and Warrior could not be used when fighting Purin the Witch has been fixed.

[h3][b]<Bug Fixes>[/b][/h3]
- Fixed an issue that the healing bonus was not applied to skills and items that recover HP at a certain rate.
- Fixed an issue that Invoker and Apparitor did not appear from Cage and Frozen Doll.

[h3][b]<Others>[/b][/h3]
- Alleviated the situation that the Bonfire was generated far away from the entrance of the dungeon.

notes.title: [added] Update August 6
notes.content:
v.1.0.0.5

Developer Notes

With the 1.0.0.4 update, the "1TK" (One Turn Kill) strategy being used to defeat bosses too quickly, has been made more difficult to execute. (This tactic has not been completely eliminated)

We believe that the ideal attack balance does not give an advantage to either the 1TK strategy or the Party (Tank/Attacker/Healer) strategy, but rather makes it possible to defeat the bosses with whichever strategy the player prefers.

However, there's no denying the powerful merits of the 1TK strategy. As such, we plan to add in more risks to balance out the upsides. (High risk / high reward)

We also adjusted the effects of skills with either no risks or risks that were easily eliminated. Furthermore, we buffed the abilities of unpopular Heroes in order to expand the range of possible strategies.

And, we are planning the content and system updates below:
-	Hero costume and hair color change functions
-	New Arena Mode
-	Add "Successor" difficulty level (temporary name)

Enjoy!


Improvements
- Power adjustments for skills which deal damage in proportion to HP/MP will now display correctly.
(Overpower/Flesh From Bone/Eradicate/Lay on Hands/Self Destruct/Quick Fire/Shield Bash)
- Fixed spots with duplicate Skill/Effect icons.
- Skill duration no longer resets when applying a skill while the same skill is already applied and its remaining duration is longer.
- The name of a skill which activates after a specific duration of time will now be displayed in text.
- The "Use Item" icon is now shown at all times while in dungeons.
- The menu will automatically jump to the last-opened page when opening or closing the main menu by controller or shortcut.
- While waiting for the subjugation force, additional explanatory text will also be displayed.
- Added new shortcuts.
　* Both the arrow keys and WASD keys can now be used to move or navigate menus.
　* Changed the Object Event shortcut key binding to F.
　* The Tab key now opens the menu.
　* Future updates will add a page explaining the keyboard shortcuts.



Balance Changes (Heroes)
- Warrior
* Indiscrimination Accuracy penalty lowered from -30% to -15%. Critical hits no longer occur.
* Taunt Aggro increased from 300% to 400%. Cooldown lowered from 5 to 4.
* Shield Bash damage changed from 60% to 80%

Developer comments: Indiscrimination now results in very powerful attacks in any fight, even monster hunts and boss battles. With the lower Accuracy penalty rate and elimination of Critical hits, it remains an effective attack skill for hunts. But, because risks were reduced, we also reduced its damage potential in boss battles.

- Warlock
* Necrosis effect changed from 20% Magic Resistance reduction to 10% Harmful Effect Resistance reduction.
* Dark Passenger Accuracy bonus eliminated. This skill has also been modified so that duration can no longer be extended further.

Developer comments: As the job concept for the Warlock is a class that hinders enemies, we changed the effect of Necrosis to better match the Warlock's role. For Dark Passenger, the problem was that it was far too easy to eliminate the risk of falling into a Coma. So, we have increased the risks to be more in proportion to the powerful abilities of this skill.


- Ranger
* Added a Free Action to Quick Fire skill effect.

- Cook
* Lowered the Accuracy penalty of Cooking Spirit from -10% to -5%.
* Increased the Effect Chance of Food Poisoning from 50% to 75%, which will now also inflict the Weakness debuff.
* Base Attack Power increases based on the Cook's level.

- Priest
* Increased Well of Life healing from 100% to 150%. Increased Cooldown from 3 to 5. Also, gave  Priests the ability to remove Coma.

- Exile
* Increased Flesh From Bone HP bonus from 100% to 150%.
* Added a Free Action to Scapegoat effect. Increased Cooldown from 0 to 2.

- Charmer
* Changed Concentration's Evasion and Harmful Effect Resistance from 50% to 30%.

- Apparitor
* Increased the Attack Power of Interrogate from 40% to 60%. Attack Power now drops 20% with each attack.
* Increased Cooldown for Interrogate+ from 0 to 2. Attack Power now drops 10% with each attack.

Developer comments: Apparitors were performing poorly in battles against regular monsters. Therefore, we increased their base Attack Power so that they have good strength even when under only a few strengthening effects. We also made adjustments to address balance issues with Attack Power becoming too high based on the number of strengthening effects.

- Nose Picker trait penalty changed to -30% Harmful Effect Resistance.


Balance Changes (Items)
- Witch's Cauldron
* Slightly lowered the success rate for crafting consumable items.
* Stopped two or more Mythical-grade items from appearing at the same time.

- Changed Sasquatch Mustache Aggro from -100% to -80%.

- Changed the range of Powder of Haste to affect one row of allies instead of all allies.

Developer's comments: Powder of Haste had too strong an effect for how easy it was to acquire. So, we've changed Haste penalty and narrowed the AOE so that it would be used more judiciously.


Balance Changes (Monsters and Battles)
- Added the Recovered from Electrocute status. Characters are now protected from being Electrocuted again for one turn after recovering from Electrocute. (Effect similar to Recovered from Stun/Mesmerize)

Developer's comments: We noticed it was too easy for characters to repeatedly be Electrocuted. We thought our players would get irritated if we didn't fix this. On the flip side, this status effect made it very easy to render bosses powerless. So, we adjusted the skill to make it difficult to inflict repeatedly, like other effects, in an effort to eliminate these situations.　

- When Purin the Witch battles a Charmer, Mystic Incense and Snake Pot are now replaced with Brave Incense and Rattlesnake Dance.

- Revised the effects of Haste. When the effects of Haste wear off, characters now take a Speed penalty and are inflicted with the Burnout debuff, which prevents the Haste effect from being reapplied. The same applies for the Rogue's Adrenaline Skill. After its duration is complete, the character it was used on is now also hit with the Burnout debuff.

- Increased HP by around 100-200 for Level 6+ boss monsters, excluding Mainframe OMEGA and Purin the Witch.

Developer's comments: This change has been made to increase the risk of using a 1TK strategy. Changes were also made so that players don't feel a significant difference in game difficulty following balance adjustments, including increases to Hero abilities.

- Changed the Genie of the Lamp's weakness from Dark to Light.

- Added fixed skill Five Finger Death Blast to Purin the Witch. The simpler the player's party of Heroes, the more frequently this skill will activate.

- Acsam now able to execute Irresistable Offer on his first turn.



Bug Fixes
- Fixed the HP Bar animation not functioning properly.

- Fixed a problem where the battle falls into a loop if Phase 1 of Mainframe OMEGA is defeated with the Monk's Deadly Flow.

- Fixed a problem with a single Skeleton Hoplite enemy formation using Protect.

- Changed requirements for the Steam achievement "Mass Production" because they were deemed too difficult.

- Fixed a problem whereby the party could be reduced to zero characters by dismissing or succeeding Heroes.

- Fixed a problem where the traits Moment of Clarity and Timid did not appear.

- Fixed a problem where Dietrich's spoken line failed to appear when executing Mirror Image+.

- Fixed a problem where the "Not Enough Inventory Space." message appeared after successfully acquiring items with Take All.

- Fixed a problem where the game froze if the player used Apocalypse when Purin the Witch was Confused.

- Fixed a problem where the game froze if the timing of a Tumor Ghoul's Pus Bomb and a Ranger's Ambush overlapped.

- Fixed a problem where the text explaining Hero traits in the Tavern's list of hireable Heroes remained on screen even after closing the Tavern.

- Fixed a problem where enemy shield ability values were still being applied even after being destroyed by a Chain Attack.

- Fixed a problem where Chain Lightning was not being strengthened even when a Druid was equipped with a Raiden Reactor.


Other
- In commemoration of 20,000 downloads, the Lottery Seller NPC will now appear in the Tavern during the second half of the game.

(added August 7, 2020)
In this patch note, there was info that was missing.
We would like to apologize for any inconvenience caused.

*Just fixed the description; the skill effect has not been changed.

notes.title: Update July 23
notes.content:
v.1.0.0.4

<Developer Notes>
The core philosophy of this game revolves around finding the best combination of equipment, heroes, traits, and skills to bring out the maximum potential of your party. However, the synergy of certain items and skills has been found to boost performance more than originally expected–in some cases this increased damage has been allowing for bosses to be defeated in one round. In light of this, we felt a few balance adjustments were needed.
Balance adjustments will be made to assure that battles do not finish too quickly, while also maintaining the strength of the aforementioned combinations as much as possible.
Balance adjustments are likely to continue for some time as the difficulty level of the latter half of the game is expected to be affected by the ongoing increase in player skill levels.
Adjustments to each Hero class based on data collected from all players will also be implemented in the near future.



<Balance Adjustments: Heroes>
-Warrior
*The Speed of Preemptive War has been raised from 10 to 20 and its Accuracy has been lowered from 30% to 25%.
*The Attack Power of Turn the Tables has been lowered from 80% to 60% and can now only be used if the user's HP is lower than 50%.

-Paladin
*Valor will now only fill the Ultimate Gauge to 75 instead of 100.

-Rogue
*The number of Action Points gained from Adrenaline has been lowered from 3 to 2.
*The effect of Rip has been lowered from 400% Attack Power to 300%.

-Mage
*Changes to Haste are detailed below.
-Haste can no longer be applied to targets that are already affected by Haste.
-Haste+ no longer applies a buff and has had its Cooldown shortened by 1.
-The same mechanisms have been implemented for Potion of Haste and Powder of Haste.

-Warlock
*The effect of Necrosis will no longer stack.
*The effect of Dark Passenger has been changed from +50% Attack Power to +15 Attack Power.

-Ranger
*The Accuracy penalty for Penetrative Fire has been removed.
*Quickfire damage is now increased proportional to Speed.
*Added Free Action to First-Aid.
*Raised the damage of Arrow of Firmament from 125% to 150%.

-Cook
*Raised the damage of Chop from 40% to 50%.
*Raised the Fire DMG of Cooking Torch from 20% to 30%.
*Raised the damage of Flash Freeze from 85% to 100%.

-Charmer
*Consolidated the 6 buffs of Dance of Delight into 1 buff.
*The effect of Brave Incense has been changed from +50% Attack Power to +15 Attack Power.

-Invoker
*Increased the amount of healing received when using Urge.
*Increased the damage of Conclusion from 20% to 30%, in addition to increasing the damage it deals proportional to the user's HP.

-Removed the penalties associated with the Expertise traits.
-Lowered the Accuracy penalty of Myopia from -10% to -5% and its Accuracy bonus from 20% to 15%.

-Lowered the effectiveness of items, skills, and effects associated with Crits and Crit Power across the board.

-The mechanisms of skills such as Overpower, Eradicate, and Flesh From Bone that deal damage based on the user's status have been adjusted to deal damage proportional to a set percentage instead of the absolute value of each status.


<Balance Adjustments: Monsters>
-The HP of Elite Monsters that appear in the Arena has been raised by 50%.
-The Speed of high-level monsters has been increased across the board.
-Added a -10% Accuracy penalty to the Giant Rock Golem's Rock and Roll skill.
-The base resistance of the Archdemon has been raised from 30% to 40%.
-Raised the Dietrich Double's Attack Power by 10%.
OMEGA's Gamma Ray Laser can no longer be delayed by effects such as Electrocute.

<Balance Adjustments: Items>
-The effects of the Doom Blade have been adjusted.
*Attack Power has been lowered from 40 to 28, Crit Rate has been lowered from 10% to 5%, Accuracy Penalty has been lowered from -1% to -2%.
*The Doom Blade's penalty will now be applied every time it deals damage to an enemy.
-The effect of the Helm of Overwhelming Power has been changed from +100% Attack Power to +16.
-Balance adjustments have been made to the Mysterious Forge and the Witch's Cauldron.
*Increased the likelihood of raising a crafted item's grade. (Not including mythical-grade items.)
*Lowered the likelihood of mythical grade items appearing.
*Increased the likelihood of crafting failures.
-Ultimate charges granted by high-grade items have been lowered across the board.
-Added Speed stat for all Footwear items.
-Lowered the HP state of the Ring of Domination from 100 to 50 and its Attack Power state from 20 to 12.


<Improvements>
-Having negative Mental Control will no longer impact the recovery of Mental State in the village.
*As usual, when Mental Control is positive, there will be bonus recovery.

-Objects have been added to dungeons.
*The Fallen Dragon Statue will only appear in dungeons at night. In exchange for applying a powerful buff to all allies, it will reset the map to its initial state.
-Final Accuracy and Effect Chance will now be displayed above an enemy's HP bar when the enemy is selected.
*When multiple effects will be applied, only one Effect Chance will be displayed.


<Bug Fixes>
-Fixed an issue with Steam achievements not being acquired after completing a quest.
*When the right conditions are met, achievements can be acquired after completing each quest.
-Fixed multiple issues that occurred when applying effects. This includes effects not being applied to Heroes due to the party's line formation, and effects from Heroes in the roster to be applied to the current party.
-Fixed an issue with the equipment effect of the Demon Sword still being applied to Heroes even after unequipping.
-Fixed an issue with Mana Powder displaying an incorrect recovery amount.
-Fixed an issue that caused a Warrior with the Two-Handed trait to sometimes be shown carrying a shield.

-Fixed an issue that prevented ingredients from being added to the Witch's Cauldron.
-Fixed an issue that prevented all of the effects of a piece of equipment from applying when that equipment included the same effect as another piece of equipment being worn.
-Fixed an issue that allowed a Confused Hero to use skills that share the same Cooldown with no restrictions. (The Warrior's Change Stance skill, the Ranger's Elemental Arrow skill, and the Rogue's Envenom skill, etc.)
-Fixed an issue that prevented Ore deposits and Veins of Lava from being mined with 0 Stamina.
-Fixed an issue that kept a dead Hero's items included in the player's Inventory.
-Fixed an issue that prevented the animation for a Troll's Savage Shout from playing after being used.
-Fixed an issue with Stamina being consumed twice upon using movement objects such as the Rabbit Hole or Zipline.
-Fixed an issue that allowed skills such as Protect and Buck Passing to be activated even when a Hero has Fainted.
-Fixed an issue that prevented the player from changing Aria's job to Time Traveler after a Time Traveler has been befriended.


<Other>
-Amended certain URLs and images that are compiled in the Fan Art section of the Artbook.

Fixed the phenomenon that the bonus from the HP of the Paladin's Hand was not properly applied.

Ver1.0.0.3
<Balance Adjustments>
-The effects of the Paladin's "Anti-Magic Shell" Skill and the "Potion of Magic Resistance" item no longer overlap.

-Improved the placement of certain numerals in the English text.

-Fixed an issue with Skill Cooldowns and Skill Requirements not being refreshed immediately during Battle.
-Fixed a bug that allowed the player to ask the Genie of the Lamp for 2 wishes.
-Buff effects gained at the Church can no longer be copied.
